data.narrative:
Xcimer Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Conner Galloway and Alexander Valys, having raised over $100M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 11 total companies—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers—including same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables such as Fuse Energy ($200M Series A), Nano Nuclear Energy ($808M Seed), and Valar Atomics ($6.0B Series B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base ($100M), applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yielding $200M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies produces $808M, with a range spanning $200M to $6.0B. The dispersion reflects stage heterogeneity within the comp set: Valar Atomics at Series B trades at a substantial premium, while Fuse Energy at Series A aligns with the stage-progression result.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $170M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $504M. Key uncertainties include the appropriate weighting between stage-progression and peer-median methods given the wide peer dispersion, and the relevance of the Series B Valar Atomics comparable. The $200M–$808M band, bounded by stage-aligned peers, represents the most defensible range pending additional disclosure on technology maturity and capital requirements.
